title: palcheck section-7 scan_col indexes px at cx without an x-bounds guard (siblings check both axes)
detail: Only yi is bounds-checked; cx reads the LoadImageColors buffer unguarded while scan_box/scan_dot guard both axes. The centered-camera fixture keeps cx near win_w/2, so any fixture/camera drift becomes an out-of-bounds read instead of a skipped pixel.
recommended_fix: Guard the column before indexing, matching the siblings: `if cx < 0 || cx >= int(img.width) { continue }` (or hoist a checked `xi := cx` like scan_box).
